description: This file contains functions for generating JSON representations of various metrics related to OFH (Open Fronthaul) in a 3GPP context, including uplink/downlink metrics, Ethernet metrics, and sector-specific data.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts closed_rx_window_metrics and timing_metrics structures to JSON.

methods.name: generate_received_messages
methods.description: Generates JSON for received messages metrics with timing info.

methods.name: generate_ethernet_rx
methods.description: Generates JSON for Ethernet receiver metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_decoder_item
methods.description: Generates JSON for individual message decoding performance metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_decoder
methods.description: Generates JSON for message decoding performance metrics including prach and data processing.

methods.name: generate_uplink
methods.description: Generates JSON for uplink metrics including received messages, Ethernet, and decoding.

methods.name: generate_ethernet_tx
methods.description: Generates JSON for Ethernet transmitter metrics.

methods.name: generate_tx_data_flow
methods.description: Generates JSON for transmission data flow performance metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_encoder
methods.description: Generates JSON for message encoder metrics.

methods.name: generate_message_transmitter
methods.description: Generates JSON for message transmitter metrics.

methods.name: generate_transmitter_statistics
methods.description: Generates JSON for overall transmitter statistics.

methods.name: generate_downlink
methods.description: Generates JSON for downlink metrics including Ethernet, message encoder, and transmitter.

methods.name: generate_ofh_cell
methods.description: Generates JSON for OFH cell metrics including PCI, uplink, and downlink.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main function to generate comprehensive JSON report for OFH metrics and sectors.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Converts OFH metrics JSON report to a formatted string with optional indentation.
